[I4EHMSFD]: 218, n. 6 gives coordinates for "dri'u lhas" -  a monastery in Lho of gNyal, east-southeast of Yar lung, near the border of present-day Bhutan - that correspond to those of gSang phu Ne'u thog, i.e. 29.5483, 91.0862.
Same place as Brin las (ID:4357), also given as Dri'u lhas?
